sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wet Job - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, good to see you! It is good to see you are still alive, haha. As you can see, my men and I have established the strongest presence on the coast. This is also where we communicate with our partners and buyers. We have managed to use the local meteorological equipment to transmit signals. However, scavengers, and not only them, keep trying to damage or destroy our antennas. We regularly deal with communication issues, and we even had to install surveillance cameras. But, as we know, vandals only understand force. Make it clear that the weather station and the entire shore are not places where people can damage our property without consequences. Show them exactly who they are interfering with. Use Blue Helmet equipment."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 Scavs with an M4A1, M16, ADAR, or TX-15 on Shoreline

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 1,100 Dollars
  - 1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× FN Five-seveN MK2 5.7x28 pistol (FDE)
- 1× 5.7x28mm L191 ammo pack (50 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of FN Five-seveN MK2 5.7x28 pistol (FDE) at Peacekeeper LL2
"Scav raids have stopped almost completely. It seems they finally understood the situation."
